event.distribution_pattern: distributed in CA, CO, FL, IA, IL, MT, NM, and Puerto Rico.

products.product_description: Foodservice item, Norpac Catalog Number 08099, frozen FLAV-R-PAC Roasted Spicy Potatoes O'brien, 6/40 oz. (2.5 lbs.) clear poly bags per case. Master Case # 100488000080997. The affected product was packaged in a clear poly bags and has no label. The affected product's master case white label is read in parts: "***FLAV-R-PAC ***ROASTED SPICY POTATOES O'BRIEN *** KEEP FROZEN *** 6/40 oz. Polybags***48800 08099***".
products.code_info: Code: 5J9 21X8 - BEST BY JUN 2021. Code 509 15X8 - BEST BY NOV 2021.
products.reason_for_recall: FLAV-R-PAC Roasted Spicy Potatoes Obrien was recalled due to undeclared wheat and soy.
